 Chitwan’s Malan hits first half-century of NPL-3 
 Onlinekhabar 
 Tuesday, October 27, 2026 
 0 Comments 
 Kathmandu, October 27 
 Chitwan Rhinos opener Dawid Malan has hit the first half-century of the third edition of the Nepal Premier League (NPL).
 In the match under way against Biratnagar Kings at the TU Cricket Ground, Malan reached his fifty off 41 balls. He was dismissed after scoring 70 off 51 balls.
 He struck five fours and five sixes. Andre Russell took the wicket of Malan on the second ball of the 13th over.
